name: reinforcement-pilot
about: Reinforcement pilot: does a hybrid penalty make choosiness evolve upward (pickier, lower sigma)? Sexual reproduction with the evolvable choosiness gene; the river splits the range for 30 sim-min (allopatric divergence into subspecies), then dries up (secondary contact) for 30 sim-min. Hybrids = offspring of parents from different subspecies; with penalty 0.8 they fail 80% of the time. Control: penalty 0 (cycle 8: choosiness then drifts towards less picky). Instinct mode, trait costs on, 4 paired replicates.
